text:
nina: Kumo found the sunniest corner and converted my laptop stand into a hammock. pic: https://images.example/kumo-hammock.jpg :heart_eyes_cat:
aj: OMG that belly flop :rofl: so floofy
kevin: Is that the new travel hammock or did he just upgrade your ergonomics? :laughing:
sana: we need a tiny blanket and a tiny 'do not disturb' sign :tada:
devin: reminds me of Otis last week — knocked over a succulent, 10/10 chaos :face_with_tears_of_joy:
nina: He also perfected the slow purr rumble. 3-hour nap, then rolled off and almost took my coffee. :cry::coffee:
maria: vote: should we start a #desk-zoos channel for these pics? :ballot_box_with_ballot:
aj: :thumbsup: yes pls
sana: :raised_hands: absolutely
kevin: yes, more daily critter drops pls
ops-bot: Reminder: please keep liquids a safe distance from on-prem kit and label any food left in shared fridges. :warning:
nina: Haha noted. I rescued the coffee and Kumo is now planning his revenge nap on my keyboard. will post a boomerang later. :camera_with_flash:
_notes: single slack thread string; short, informal messages with emoji, mention of a picture link, and a brief ops reminder.
